chapter: Kid Rene, Chris Kelly and the bungalow
title: Travel limits and the Black and Tan after Chris Kelly
summary: With Kelly he stayed near home, then played the Black and Tan with Professor Mineta, Henry Martin and others.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: Well did you ever travel out of the city with Chris Kelly at all? Did you ever do any traveling with him?
No, no. I mean we used to go from here to Bugalooza or over the lake like that, something like that, but never to go too far.
Did you play with Chris until he died?
Which band did you go to after you left Chris?

When I left Chris Kelly I went to play at the Black and Tan. Black and Tan right there goes to the Never-Tan, Black and Tan Cabaret on the label. I played for Kit Shots, Professor Mineta, Henry Martin, Udell, and myself on drum. Five piece bands. That's the band at the Black and Tan? Yes. Next to the Lyric Theater, along in there. Yeah, the Lyric Theater. Anybody, we'll be through here in a minute, I guess you're getting tired talking so many of our questions. Oh, that's all right.
